_extraction_flags.notes: Excellent O-ISAC paper! Photonic sub-THz ISAC at D-band (110-170 GHz). Similar to O_ISAC_002 but higher performance. Purple Mountain Labs.

reasoning_trace.step_0_visual_inspection: Fig.1: Comprehensive system schematic with Tx (OFC + UTC-PD), Comm Rx (harmonic mixer + OTU), Radar Rx (dechirping). Photos of all modules. Fig.2: SNR/BER vs IOP/ROP. Fig.4: 2D radar imaging resolving 2.5 cm targets.
reasoning_trace.step_1_concept_analysis: System: Photonics-aided sub-THz ISAC at D-band. FDM: 151 GHz communication (DP-QPSK/16QAM) + 124 GHz LFM sensing. Optical frequency comb (OFC) for low phase noise in sensing. Fiber-THz-fiber architecture for real-time comm. MIMO with dual-polarization.
reasoning_trace.step_2_benchmark_verification: Comm: 251.03 Gbps (200-GbE, 16QAM, 31.38 GBaud). BER 1.6e-6 at 8.5 dBm. Sensing: 10 GHz LFM BW, 2.5 cm resolution, 10.3 m range. CRQ = 100.41 Gbps/cm. Table 1 compares with SOTA.
reasoning_trace.step_3_strategic_critique: Contribution: First 200+ Gbps-scale + cm-scale sensing demonstration. OFC eliminates frequency offset/phase noise. Real-time comm (not offline). Hybrid optical-THz system.

bibliographic.title: Demonstration of Photonic Sub-THz ISAC System with Real-Time 251.03-Gbps Communication Rate and Offline 2.5-cm Sensing Resolution
bibliographic.authors: Mingzheng Lei, Zhidong Lyu, Qingzhi Zhou, Junhao Zhang, Hao Li, Bingchang Hua, Jiao Zhang, Yuancheng Cai, Junjie Ding, Xingyu Chen, Lu Zhang, Jianjun Yu, Min Zhu

application.scenario_description: High-speed real-time communication and high-resolution radar imaging for 6G applications.

key_contribution.key_contribution: First demonstration of 200+ Gbps real-time communication and cm-scale sensing in a photonic sub-THz ISAC system. CRQ of 100.41 Gbps/cm.
key_contribution.gap_addressed: Previous systems had CRQ < 50 Gbps/cm or used offline communication processing.

identification.scenario_label: D-band Photonic ISAC with Real-Time Comm

transmitter.notes: OFC at 1550.032 nm, 31 GHz repetition. DP-QPSK/16QAM at 31.38 GBaud. LFM 10 GHz BW. UTC-PD heterodyne to THz.

receiver.notes: Comm Rx: Harmonic mixer + DP-MZM + OTU-Rx. Radar Rx: Dechirping + 1.25 GSa/s DSO.

integration.notes: FDM: 151 GHz comm + 124 GHz sensing. Dual-polarization MIMO. Separate Tx/Rx antennas.

waveform.notes: FDM: DP-16QAM at 151 GHz + LFM chirp at 124 GHz. Orthogonal in frequency.

channel_wireless.notes: 10.3 m wireless distance. D-band (110-170 GHz). Indoor laboratory.

comm_metrics.notes: 251.03 Gbps real-time (200-GbE mode). BER below SD-FEC (2.2e-2). SNR ~19 dB.

sensing_metrics.notes: 10 GHz LFM gives 1.5 cm theoretical (c/2B). Achieved 2.5 cm with 3 metal targets. 2D Range-Doppler imaging.

tradeoff.notes: CRQ (Capacity-Resolution Quotient) = 100.41 Gbps/cm. FDM avoids interference.
